title: quercus × duriensis
intro: Quercus × duriensis, commonly known as the hybrid of Portuguese oak and Spanish oak, is a deciduous tree species native to the Iberian Peninsula. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include the ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and support antioxidant defenses due to its rich content of polyphenols. The therapeutic actions of Quercus × duriensis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. However, more research is required to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic potential.
